sections.title: Attaching a whole sentence with hogy
sections.content: hogy ("that") lets you attach a whole sentence as the object of remélem ("I hope") or a célom az, hogy... ("my goal is that..."). Everything after hogy is a normal, independent sentence — nothing changes about how it conjugates.

items.spanish: Remélem, hogy jövőre folyékonyan beszélek magyarul.
items.english: I hope that next year I'll speak Hungarian fluently.

items.spanish: A célom az, hogy minden nap gyakorlok egy kicsit.
items.english: My goal is that I practice a little every day.

sections.content: remélem is the definite "I hope" form (from remél) — used here as a fixed opener, exactly like ismerem or tudom, followed by a comma and then hogy plus a full sentence.
